validation_commands.name: core lint and tests
validation_commands.command: cd core && python3 -m venv /tmp/nidavelir-core-validation && . /tmp/nidavelir-core-validation/bin/activate && python -m pip install -q -e '.[dev]' && ruff check . && pytest -q

validation_commands.name: mcp lint and tests
validation_commands.command: cd mcp && python3 -m venv /tmp/nidavelir-mcp-validation && . /tmp/nidavelir-mcp-validation/bin/activate && python -m pip install -q -e '.[dev]' && ruff check . && pytest -q

validation_commands.name: web build
validation_commands.command: cd web && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build
